About the Team SRE Middleware & Data (SRE M&D) enables product teams by providing secure, scalable, and automated data, middleware, and AI services on Azure. Provisioning: Automates secure delivery of databases, queues, caches, and AI services/resources;
builds self-service andguardrails. Reliability: Ensures availability, performance, and resilience of data, middleware, and AI services in production;
builds observability, autohealing, and disaster recovery. What You Will Do Lead and grow the team: Manage, mentor, and develop SRE engineers across Provisioning and Reliability. Lead cross-team initiatives: Align roadmaps with Architects and partner teams;
ensure adoption of architecture standards. Run design reviews and architecture signoffs;
surface and mitigate risks and complexity early. Translate standards into guardrails and automation (policyascode, selfservice) for consistent delivery. Apply lightweight RACI and clear escalation paths to resolve tradeoffs quickly. Drive roadmap and execution: Provisioning: Self-service engines, Crossplane/Terraform-based automation, policy-as-code, secured pipelines, access management, backups/restore, Azure AI resource provisioning, and quota management. Reliability: Observability integrations (New Relic, Azure Monitor), performance tuning, autohealing, DR/BCP, resilience testing, failover automation, SLOs, reliability for Azure AI services and messaging platforms (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus). Establish engineering excellence: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Crossplane) and CI/CD best practices. Change management with safe deploys and rollback strategies. Incident and problem management with blameless postmortems. Continuous improvement loops measured by DORA/SRE metrics. Champion security and compliance by design: Policy as code, least privilege access, and secrets/identity hygiene. Guardrails in self-service flows;
auditability and evidence collection. Partnership with Security/Compliance for standards and reviews. Partner with the Architects: Codevelop platform architecture and service standards. Define SLIs/SLOs and capacity/reliability patterns for core services. Align roadmaps and run design reviews for high-impact changes. Own delivery outcomes: Navigate competing priorities across a broad platform scope — balancing reactive operational load (incidents, toil, on-call) against proactive platform investment (self-service, automation, resilience) without a clean separation between the two. Make and communicate prioritization decisions under ambiguity, with partial information, across teams that have conflicting urgency. Maintain a defensible, visible backlog that reflects real risk and business impact — not just the loudest stakeholder. Operate a healthy on-call: High-quality playbooks and automation-first troubleshooting (AI-assisted). Actionable alerts with SLO-based paging and noise reduction. Regular resilience testing and post-incident hardening. Initiatives You Will Lead: Self-service provisioning for databases, queues, and caches with golden configurations and policy guardrails. AI-assisted troubleshooting for provisioning and production incidents. Platform wide observability integration for data, middleware, and AI services (New Relic, Azure Monitor). Automated DR runbooks and resilience/chaos testing in production. Performance tuning at service and query layers, including automated tuning workflows. Standardization of provisioning via Terraform/Crossplane for databases, messaging, and AI services. Governance for Azure AI services (quotas, access, safety guardrails) with clear consumption patterns for product teams. Success Metrics Reduced MTTR and incident count, improved SLO attainment for data/middleware services. Improved lead time for change and change failure rate;
increased automation coverage and reduced toil. Faster time to provision and higher first success rate for self-service requests. Measurable improvements in cost efficiency, performance, and capacity predictability. Team health: engagement, growth, hiring velocity, stress levels, and retention. SLO attainment for AI endpoints and messaging services;
reduced alert noise viaimproved observability (New Relic/Azure Monitor). What You Will Bring Proven experience managing SRE/platform/infrastructure teams delivering production-critical services. Deep familiarity with Azure and the team stack: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB;
Redis;
messaging systems such as CloudAMQP/RabbitMQ, Kafka, Event Hubs, and Service Bus. Strong reliability fundamentals: SLOs/SLIs, incident and problem management, capacity, DR/BCP, performance tuning. Solid automation background: IaC (Terraform/Crossplane), CI/CD (Azure DevOps), GitOps, policyascode, secrets and identity, RBAC. Track record of building selfservice platforms and reducing toil. Excellent crossfunctional leadership with product, security, and compliance partners. Experience operating Azure AI services in production (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search). Observability experience with New Relic, Azure Monitor, and OpenTelemetry. What You’ll Need Advanced skills in English Experience with AI-assisted operations and troubleshooting. Observability expertise (Prometheus/Grafana, New Relic, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry). Database performance engineering and query optimization. Experience in regulated environments and security frameworks. FinOps capabilities (cost governance, forecasting, rightsizing, quotas, budgets, chargeback/showback). How We Work Collaboration first with a strong partnership between the Engineering Manager and the Architects. Automation by default;
security and reliability are nonnegotiable. Blameless postmortems, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes. Participation in an equitable on-call rotation with high-quality runbooks and automation. Tech Environment Azure (AKS, managed databases, storage, networking, identity). Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search). Azure DevOps for CI/CD. CloudAMQP (RabbitMQ). Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB. Caches: Redis. Queues/Brokers: Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus. Terraform/Crossplane, GitOps. Observability: New Relic, Azure Monitor, logs, metrics, traces, alerting workflows.

title: Recruiter (Fluent English)
description:
Responsibilities : Coordinate and schedule interviews, ensuring all logistics are in place, including interviewers' availability, meeting rooms, and necessary equipment. Serve as a point of contact for internal stakeholders regarding interview scheduling and provide timely updates on interview status. Coordinate pre-employment activities, such as reference checks, background screenings, and employment verifications, ensuring timely completion and documentation. Manage the day-to-day administration of the company's total rewards programs, including compensation, benefits, and employee recognition initiatives. Collaborate with external vendors and internal stakeholders to ensure benefit payments, deductions and contributions are processed timely and accurately. Data error management and resolution between systems to ensure accurate outputs and processing. Provide clear and timely communication to end users and stakeholders. Partner with external service providers for outsourced health and welfare benefit administration and external enrollment support. Manage and administer employee separation activities, including severance calculations, preparation, preparing separation packages, and coordinating with relevant stakeholders. Provide employees with all necessary documentation and act as point of contact for any inquiries or issue resolution throughout the separation and offboarding process with empathy and professionalism. Ensure accurate and timely data administration related to employee separations, including updating HRIS systems, maintaining separation records, and document retention. Identify opportunities for process optimization and collaborate with key stakeholders to implement improvements, optimize workflows, and enhance the overall effectiveness across the Total Rewards landscape. To include system and process automation opportunities. Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations related, ensuring compliance. You will be successful in this role if you have: Error reporting and resolution experience: You will work with various systems and software to manage and administer processes across the hire-to-retire life cycle. The ability to identify and report errors or discrepancies between systems is crucial. You should be able to troubleshoot and resolve issues efficiently, ensuring accurate data and smooth system operations. Problem-solving skills: When encountering errors or discrepancies, you should possess strong problem-solving skills. This involves analyzing the situation, identifying root causes, and implementing effective solutions to prevent recurrence. Attention to data integrity: Ensuring data integrity is essential when managing total rewards programs. You should have a keen eye for detail and be committed to maintaining accurate and consistent data across systems. Regularly perform data audits and implement data validation processes to minimize errors. Technical proficiency: Familiarity with HRIS systems, data management tools, and reporting software is crucial for error reporting and resolution. Proficiency in using these tools will enable you to effectively identify and address system errors or data inconsistencies. Communication and collaboration: When reporting errors between systems, clear and timely communication with relevant stakeholders is essential. You should be able to articulate the issue, its impact, and proposed solutions to technical teams, HR colleagues, and management. Collaborate with IT or system administrators to resolve errors promptly. Continuous improvement mindset: Strive for continuous improvement in system processes and data management. Identify opportunities for automation, streamlining workflows, and implementing error prevention measures. Keep up with technological advancements and industry best practices to enhance system efficiency and accuracy. Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in HR administration or a similar role. Strong knowledge of HR principles, practices, and regulations. Experience in knowledge management and case management systems. Proficiency preferred in using HRIS systems (e.G., Oracle) for data management and reporting. Experience working in Oracle, ADP (Global View) a plus. Must be proficient in English;
preferred language capabilities Spanish or Portuguese.

Experience Level: 7+ years Location: Remote Tech Stack: TypeScript + React, Prisma, Fastify, Mantine Contract Type: Full-time, B2B contract About the Role Radity is a global software engineering company delivering innovative digital solutions to clients around the world. We are passionate about building great technology and fostering a collaborative environment where people grow, take ownership, and make a real impact. Our client is a US insurance company, subsidiary of Fortune 500 companies. This is an “insurance startup” with an agile culture and approach to work, and future oriented approach to technology. Product is internally developed Claims Management system. The product is in the early development stage. Once MVP goes live, project will continue to stabilize the product and enhance it with new features and AI -powered workflows embedded directly into real business processes. Radity is running software development projects with the client for more than 3 years. This is not an outsourcing role, but a real product engineering role, where you will be part of a big joint Radity and Client team. Engineers are trusted with context, real problems, and responsibility for delivering outcomes. You’ll work closely with product managers, designers, and sometimes clients to design, build, and evolve a complex platform used by insurance professionals every day. What You’ll Do Own features end to end — from understanding the business problem to solution design, implementation, deployment, and iteration Design and build backend services using TypeScript, Prisma and Fastify Develop modern frontend features using React and TypeScript Work with PostgreSQL Contribute to the evolution of the platform architecture and technical standards Build and integrate AI-powered workflows that support complex claims management business flows, using existing AI services and tooling where appropriate Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to shape solutions, not just implement requirements Take responsibility for testing, CI/CD, releases, and production readiness Continuously improve performance, reliability, observability, and developer experience Use modern AI-assisted coding tools as part of daily engineering work What We’re Looking For 7+ years of professional experience as a software engineer Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript + React, Prisma Experience building and operating real production systems (not just isolated components) Solid understanding of system design, architecture, and trade-offs Comfort working with incomplete requirements and asking the right questions Experience with Azure or similar cloud platforms Practical experience with CI/CD, automated testing, and deployments Product-oriented mindset — focus on user value and business outcomes Active, practical use of AI tools in daily development Experience in client-facing or stakeholder discussions Upper-Intermediate English or higher Nice to have (not required) Insurtech background Compensation & Benefits Competitive market-level compensation based on experience and location Generous vacation policy Full equipment provided Paid access to modern AI tools, learning resources, and subscriptions Support for continuous learning and professional development Strong engineering culture with high trust and autonomy Why This Role High ownership and real influence on product direction Engineers are trusted to think, design, and decide, not just execute Direct Exposure to the top engineering team AI is a real working tool and part of the product, not a buzzword Long-term product vision with solid business fundamentals Recruitment process Recruiter Screen: short intro call to align on experience, mindset, location, and compensation Hiring Manager Interview: product- and case-focused discussion with an Engineering Manager (no take-home task) Interview with the Client’s CTO Offer

title: Engineer Manager
description:
Job Description Summary The Director of Engineering leads a comprehensive organization of Design, Product, Test and Process engineers responsible for the end-to-end design of Large Rotating Machines (motors, generators and synchronous condensers), Transformers, Power Drives, Switch Gear and Complex Systems for a variety of industry segments. With design authority (under corporate standards), you will be responsible for major and complex assignments with long-term business implications, manage complex issues within functional areas of expertise, and be instrumental to the overall business strategy. Job Description Role Summary/Purpose: Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) for the Power Conversion and Storage division in Latin America, the LATAM Director of Engineering will lead Engineering on Rotating machines (induction, DC, synchronous, PMM, synch reluctance, and other topologies) and Engineering of integrated electrical solutions (system design and integration, power electronics, automation, switchboards and installation) for products and projects within LATAM or exported from LATAM to many global regions, notably North America, Europe and the Middle East. The role is both operational and strategic. It demands: Transformational leadership skills – to guide the large organizational structure towards productivity, process standardization & maturity, speed and use of leading edge technology tools;
Technical depth – to foster an environment of creativity and innovative solutions, and to develop new business opportunities;
Seniority and executive presence – to interact with the customers in Latin America and abroad on complex engineering projects. The role requires focus towards growth on the Latam region operation, and he/she will leverage the GE network, to drive product innovation, technology injections, structuring and cost-out through tools and processes in the areas of power electronics, automation, power systems, switchgears, rotor dynamics, vibration, electromagnetics, insulation, aero-thermo, structural, and both electrical and mechanical systems integration. Essential Responsibilities: The LATAM Director of Engineering directs a functional area of several engineering departments across the sites of Campinas, SP and Belo Horizonte, MG. Executes projects with great customer engagement and trust. Translates concepts, considers strategic options, develops tactics, and implements change. Creates programs in alignment with the external environment. Participates in cross-functional, multi-cultural teams. Drives team performance to meet aggressive time and cost demands from our customers. Develop, implement, and achieve performance KPIs. Develop a roadmap for building world-class products and solutions, including electric machines, power electronics, switchgears, software and overall systems design capability. Serves as technical expert in the technical community through demonstrated technical accomplishments which may include holding patents, component design and systems design experience, and strong knowledge of engineering design fundamentals. Drives customer project execution and delivers on time and quality. Leads and oversees quality engineering design, execution, and product safety;
responsible for the oversight of the related sciences including materials and performance. Provides guidance, leadership, mentoring and intervention, as necessary, to strengthen the discipline, quality, reliability and rigor of our engineering work. Leads interactions with customers on technical issues. Works with Power Conversion leadership to develop and build long term strategies. Interacts with P&L engineering and technology leaders across GE to accelerate deployment of modern electrical and mechanical design tools and methodologies. Works with P&L product leadership to reshape the overall Latam technical strategy and the organizational structure. Provides leadership with high integrity and oversight of processes protecting intellectual property, export controlled and strategic technology. Required Qualification: Degree in Electric or Mechanical Engineering Strong knowledge of Engineering Design Fundamentals and Engineering Processes Extensive experience in mechanical and/or electrical systems design Fluency in English and Portuguese mandatory Industrial experience in relevant industry segments such as Oil and Gas, Power Generation, Mining & Steel and/or Marine will be a plus. Subject Matter Expertise on Rotating Machines and/or Electrical Systems will be a plus. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes #J-18808-Ljbffr

Liderar o desenho e evolução da arquitetura de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, confiabilidade e performance. Trabalhar com tecnologias modernas como Snowflake, Databricks e serviços em cloud (AWS/Azure). Gerenciar e desenvolver o time, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alta performance. Incentivar o crescimento técnico e de carreira dos engenheiros. Atuar em conjunto com Product Managers na descoberta e definição de soluções, garantindo alinhamento com necessidades do negócio. Definir e garantir boas práticas de arquitetura, engenharia e metodologias ágeis. Gerenciar e reduzir dívida técnica da plataforma. Responsabilidades do Dia a Dia: Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados e processos de ETL (Airbyte, Fivetran, Azure Data Factory). Construir e manter infraestrutura de dados robusta e escalável. Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de dados, produto, engenharia e stakeholders de negócio. Gerenciar infraestrutura com práticas modernas (Terraform, Ansible, Azure Application Insights). Garantir governança, qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados. Atuar na operação de ambientes produtivos, incluindo suporte a incidentes críticos. Promover inovação contínua e adoção de novas tecnologias, incluindo uso de IA no ciclo de desenvolvimento. Requisitos Técnicos (Obrigatórios) Experiência sólida com pipelines de dados, ETL e ambientes produtivos. Experiência com Airbyte, Fivetran, Snowflake, Databricks e Azure Data Factory. Forte domínio de SQL e modelagem de dados (incluindo grandes volumes). Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Power BI e Sigma. Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible). Programação em Python (diferencial: Scala). Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes. Conhecimento em data lakes, bancos relacionais, NoSQL e OLAP. Boa comunicação e visão orientada a produto. Inglês fluente. Diferenciais Experiência com pipelines de AI/ML e serviços como AWS SageMaker ou Azure Synapse. Vivência com governança de dados e qualidade. Background em sistemas distribuídos, APIs ou arquiteturas orientadas a eventos. Formação e Experiência Mais de 6 anos de experiência em Data Engineering (hands-on). Mais de 3 anos liderando times ou iniciativas de dados. Formação em Ciência da Computação, Data Science ou áreas correlatas.

Since then, through innovative technology and outstanding customer service, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America. With operations in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, Nubank is today one of the largest digital banking platforms and technology-leading companies in the world. Nubank was listed on the NYSE in 2021 and was recently named one of Time Magazine's 100 Most Influential Companies. For more information, visit About the Role At Nubank, our Credit Card platform is the core of our global expansion. We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join our platform team as a technical anchor, ensuring our systems remain scalable and flexible as we maintain sustainable growth and innovation in the countries where we currently operate, while also launching into new international markets. You will play a vital role in evolving the architecture of one of our most complex and strategic products. You will operate within a high-impact triad alongside Product and Management, focusing on long-term technical strategy and system health. As a hands-on technical leader, you will challenge the status quo, propose innovation and solve deep architectural problems, mentor and become a technical reference for our engineering team. Your work will directly enable millions of customers to access financial products via credit card worldwide. Responsibilities Define and drive the long-term vision and strategy for the global architecture of the core credit card platform, ensuring exponential scalability and continuous evolution capability. Lead the strategic partnership with Product and Business leadership (C-level and VPs) to shape the medium and long-term technical roadmap and define the strategic OKRs and global impact KPIs. Act as a technical and cultural reference, defining the highest standards of engineering excellence, mentoring other Architects and Principal/Staff Engineers, and fostering a culture of innovation and accountability. Lead and resolve the most ambitious and high-risk technical challenges, intervening in critical performance or resilience bottlenecks and driving technical execution for solutions with multi-system and multi-country impact. Design and oversee the execution of complex system transformations (e.G., core banking migrations, replacement of legacy platforms) ensuring regulatory compliance in multiple jurisdictions and fiscal regimes, proactively mitigating risks. Communicate and defend the technical strategy eloquently and convincingly to the executive board and non-technical audiences, translating architecture decisions into business value and competitive advantage. Required Qualifications Principal/Staff Engineer level experience or equivalent with an extensive and demonstrable history in architecting and scaling mission-critical, high-volume, and low-latency systems in global fintech or e-commerce environments. Expert proficiency (demonstrated in code and design) in multiple programming paradigms, with significant hands-on experience in functional programming (e.G., Clojure, Scala, Haskell) and reactive/event-based architectures. Proven ability to establish and lead the long-term technical strategy for entire platform ecosystems (not just isolated components), influencing the direction of multiple engineering groups. Deep and successful experience in navigating and defining the architecture in highly regulated financial environments (e.G., BACEN, FCA, SOX) and designing systems to meet data residency requirements and complex cross-border transactions. History of successfully leading and completing large-scale platform transformations (e.G., transition from monoliths to microservices mesh, migration of data centers or clouds), managing risks and operational impact. title: Gerente De Segurança Da Informação
description:
O Grupo Fleury é uma das maiores e mais respeitadas instituições de medicina e saúde do Brasil. Referência por sua excelência técnica, médica e de atendimento, é também destaque nas melhores práticas ESG. Além dos serviços de medicina diagnóstica, o Grupo Fleury conta com uma oferta crescente de serviços que buscam responder às necessidades das pessoas, além de gerar sustentabilidade para o sistema de saúde com a melhor utilização dos recursos investidos. Essas soluções refletem o posicionamento estratégico da empresa de ser um ecossistema de saúde integrada, preventiva e híbrida, combinando ofertas físicas e digitais. Acreditamos que carreira e propósito caminham juntos, e costumamos falar que somos apaixonados pelas pessoas e pelo que fazemos. Isso reflete em nosso dia a dia, por meio de um trabalho que impacta vidas. Faz parte da nossa essência cuidar das pessoas, colocando as colaboradoras, colaboradores, médicas, médicos e clientes sempre no centro. Se você tem atitude positiva, empatia, adaptabilidade e deseja se desenvolver em um ambiente repleto de profissionais referências no mercado que prezam por respeito, excelência e inovação, abrace a oportunidade de levar saúde e bem-estar para a plena realização das pessoas! Venha transformar sua paixão em carreira! Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo: Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas. Garantir a proteção e a disponibilidade das informações corporativas por meio de políticas robustas de segurança, mitigando riscos e assegurando a continuidade do negócio. Atuar de forma estratégica em projetos, integrando a segurança desde a concepção e fortalecendo a cultura organizacional. Promover a conscientização dos colaboradores, acompanhar tendências e aplicar soluções inovadoras para manter a conformidade e a resiliência digital. Além disso, liderar a gestão eficiente de recursos, negociar com parceiros e desenvolver uma equipe de alta performance, orientada a resultados e inovação contínua. Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente! Principais atividades: Liderança estratégica: Coordenação da área de Segurança da Informação, garantindo proteção, continuidade e integridade dos serviços de TI em toda a organização. Gestão de ambiente complexo: Proteção de milhares de usuários, ativos, sistemas, sites e operações críticas 24x7, incluindo unidades e parceiros. Segurança de parceiros: Garantia de acessos seguros e operação contínua para laboratórios e stakeholders externos. Planejamento estratégico: Definição e implementação da estratégia de segurança da informação, alinhada ao negócio e às melhores práticas de mercado (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS). Governança e compliance: Estruturação de políticas, processos e comitês executivos, assegurando conformidade, auditorias e evolução da maturidade em segurança. Gestão de identidade e acessos: Controle de acessos, credenciais, MFA, PAM e gestão de riscos em sistemas e infraestrutura. Gestão de incidentes: Monitoramento contínuo e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança, minimizando impactos operacionais. Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Redução de riscos por meio de atualização de patches, correção de falhas e fortalecimento da infraestrutura. Proteção de infraestrutura crítica: Administração de firewalls, acessos privilegiados e segurança perimetral. Gestão financeira: Planejamento e controle orçamentário (OPEX/CAPEX), negociação com fornecedores e otimização de investimentos. Cultura de segurança: Condução de treinamentos, campanhas de conscientização e simulações para engajamento dos colaboradores. Inovação e resiliência: Implementação de soluções modernas para antecipar ameaças e garantir conformidade regulatória. Impacto no negócio: Atuação estratégica para sustentar operações seguras e contribuir com a missão organizacional. Buscamos alguém que apresente: Formação: Superior em áreas relacionadas à Engenharia, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas afins Certificações como CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Conhecimento em Gestão de Privacidade e Riscos Conformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR) Conhecimento específicos: Políticas de segurança Soluções de arquivamento de dados para segurança e auditoria, análise forense, prática de engenharia social. Gestão direta de Red Team, Blue Team e Gestão de Acessos Campanhas de sensibilização e conscientização de segurança da informação na organização Soluções de segurança da informação tais como IPS, IDS, Firewall, criptografia, SIEM, ZTNA, MDM, ACS, Proxy, Anti-APT, WAF e demais soluções de segurança Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito. Informações da vaga: Modelo de Trabalho: Aberto a negociação ( Atuação poderá ser home, ou Hibrido) Carga Horária: 220h Escala: Segunda á sexta Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48 Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito. Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que: - Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;
- Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;
- Busquem consciênciasocial de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;
- Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;
- Planejem e executemo trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;
- Gerem e implementemnovas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado. Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada! Saúde e Bem-estar: - Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;
- Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;
- Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;
- Acesso à plataformaOrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;
- Licença maternidadee paternidade estendidas;
- Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida. Proteção e estabilidade: - Previdência privada;
- Participação nos lucros;
- Seguro de vida. Facilidades para o dia a dia: - Vale-Alimentação;
- Vale-Refeição;
- Vale-Transporte;
- Auxílio-Creche;
- Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços. Desenvolvimento e educação: - Plataforma de ensino;
- Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições. Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória. Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas. Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família. Para conhecer mais sobre o Grupo Fleury, acesse o site: O Grupo Fleury informa que a participação em seus processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhuma empresa terceira está autorizada a cobrar valores para a candidatura às vagas, ao treinamento, ao material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada.

from data collection and validation through to dashboards and customer-facing outputs Work closely with Solution Architects to ensure technical feasibility, scalability, and long-term sustainability Act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, driving clarity and momentum Lead demos, clarify scope boundaries, and align expectations on custom vs configurable functionality Support planning, estimation, sequencing, and governance across a multi-phase programme Track progress against milestones and help define what success looks like by September 2026 What You Bring: Proven ability to lead discovery independently and bring structure to ambiguous environments Experience working on data-driven products, reporting systems, or analytics platforms Experience with international, enterprise environments Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills across senior, operational, and technical audiences Confidence translating complex operational domains into clear, actionable requirements Exposure to energy, utilities, power generation, or industrial operations is highly desirable Familiarity with operational KPIs, asset performance management, and HSE reporting is a strong plus Experience working with dashboards, BI tools, or custom reporting solutions Why Join the Remobi community: Fully remote B2B / freelance contracts Access to high-impact roles across AI, FinTech, and modern infrastructure A strong community of senior engineers, curated content, and role alerts Work with fast-scaling companies where your impact is visible and valued Apply today: If you’re a Digital Business Analyst who thrives in discovery, enjoys shaping products from complex operational environments, and wants to deliver measurable business value in the energy sector - we’d love to hear from you.

description: Graphic Designer Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding. You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels. What you’ll do You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG) Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations Edit video for social distribution and website use Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace. What matters in this role You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction You understand how design actually shows up in B2B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks Requirements 4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts) Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video) Video editing experience for social and web content Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite Context for the work Our client sells to B2B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to: Driving registrations and product demos Increasing engagement Supporting sales follow-up Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good. What this is not Not a pure brand exploration role Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment Not isolated design work handed over a wall You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you. Assist with septic permits and HOA applications. Address permit application rejections in a timely manner. Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone. Qualifications: University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF. Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively. Possess strong verbal and written English skills. Must be highly organized and attentive to detail. Willing to work in high-pressure environment. Willing to be responsive and communicative. Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9AM to 5PM EST. The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal. Good attitude necessary.

description: Analista / Consultor Oracle Financials (FA) — PIS/COFINS Especialista em ERP Financeiro com foco em apuração e adequação às novas regras de PIS/COFINS Sobre a oportunidade Buscamos um profissional com sólida experiência em Oracle Financials (FA) para atuar em um projeto estratégico de análise e adequação do sistema ERP às novas regras de PIS/COFINS. O ambiente é de sistema não nativo, com alto volume de customizações, exigindo capacidade analítica para entender o estado atual da solução, identificar gaps e propor as adaptações necessárias para conformidade fiscal. Principais responsabilidades Analisar o funcionamento atual do sistema ERP Oracle FA no que tange ao processo de apuração de PIS/COFINS, mapeando fluxos, regras de negócio e customizações existentes. Identificar gaps entre a situação atual do sistema e os requisitos exigidos pela nova legislação de PIS/COFINS, propondo soluções de adequação. Trabalhar com regime misto de apuração (cumulativo e não cumulativo), com foco especial na tomada de crédito pelas entradas. Especificar e acompanhar as customizações e adaptações sistêmicas necessárias para atender às novas obrigações fiscais, em parceria com equipes técnicas e de desenvolvimento. Documentar processos de negócio e requisitos funcionais (AS IS / TO BE), garantindo rastreabilidade das decisões e aderência à legislação vigente. Apoiar testes, homologação e validação das entregas sistêmicas, assegurando conformidade tributária e integridade dos dados fiscais. Diferenciais desejáveis Experiência anterior em projetos de adequação fiscal e reforma tributária em sistemas ERP. Conhecimento em SPED Contribuições (EFD-Contribuições) e obrigações acessórias relacionadas. Noções de SQL para análise e validação de dados em ambiente Oracle. Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

description:
Role Overview Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.G., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols. ability to identify theroot causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution;

description:

You can find additional information about our values at this link ( ) The Impact You’ll Have at Voxy Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate. What You’ll Be Doing: Collections & Cash Application: - Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.
- Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.
- Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams;
documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.
- Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters;
tracks compliance withagreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP&A Manager.
- Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger;
investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.
- Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.
- Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies;
prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions. Credit Analysis & Risk Management: - Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history;
recommends credit limits and payment terms.
- Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk;
flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.
- Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies. Reporting & Analysis: - Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.
- Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.
- Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.
- Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP&A Manager or Senior FP&A Analyst. What We’re Looking For: - B.A/B.S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;
- 2+ years accountingand/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;
- Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;
- Comfortable workingin an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;
- Advanced Excelskills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;
- Based anywherein Brazil - Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish - Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus. Job Details: - Gross Salary: R$110,500/year - Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3) In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you’ll enjoy: - Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity) - Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events - Remote friendly work policies - Professional development budget - Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify - Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world - Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET) We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer. Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company. In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee. As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions;
our goal is to assemblea diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines,regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar comanalistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimentoprático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridadecom pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimentoem Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade deinvestigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente!

title: Cloud Ai/Ml Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer to lead the automation of complex financial workflows at Prosigliere. Description We are seeking a Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer with a\ "cloud-first\" mindset to join our growing team. In this role, you won't just build models;
you will architect end-to-end intelligent systems that redefine how we handle financial data. You will be responsible for analyzing manual credit request processes and identifying opportunities to automate them using cutting-edge cloud AI services. The ideal candidate bridges the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence, building tools that ingest high-stakes data from credit agencies, analyze it through sophisticated AI pipelines, and present it via human-in-the-loop dashboards. You will work closely with engineering leadership to turn manual bottlenecks into scalable, automated cloud solutions. Responsibilities Process Architecture: Analyze existing credit request workflows to identify automation opportunities using cloud-native AI/ML solutions. Intelligent Data Ingestion: Design and implement processes utilizing Document Intelligence (OCR/Form parsing), and Web Search integration to gather and structure fragmented data. Third-Party Data Synthesis: Build tools to ingest and analyze complex results from credit agencies (e.G., D&B, Experian, Equifax ) to drive automated decision-making. Custom Tooling: Develop custom software bridges to fill gaps between standard cloud AI services and specific business requirements. Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations. Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow. Technology Requirements 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a heavy focus on Cloud AI/ML implementations. Cloud-First Expertise: Proven experience with Vertex AI (GCP), Azure AI, or AWS SageMaker, specifically utilizing high-level AI services (Document AI, Search/Discovery, etc.). Data Integration: Proficiency in building API integrations and data pipelines that handle structured and unstructured data from external financial vendors. Python Mastery: Expert-level Python skills, including experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks for building agentic AI workflows. Visualization: Experience building data dashboards using tools like Streamlit, Looker, or custom React-based frontend components. Security Mindset: Deep understanding of handling sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) within cloud environments. Profile Requirements Solution Architect Mentality: Ability to look at a manual business process and map it to a technical AI roadmap. Independent Problem Solver: A self-starter who can build\ "the bridge\" when a standardout-of-the-box tool doesn't exist. Strong Communication: Ability to explain why an AI made a specific recommendation to stakeholders. Agile Learner: A commitment to staying current with the rapid pace of LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI developments. AI Tooling: Proficiency with AI-first engineering approaches and tooling is a plus. If you are familiar with the Cognition platform with Windsurf and Devin, that is even better. Certifications: Google, Azure or AWS Cloud AI certifications are a big plus!

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Analista De Growth Marketing | Growth Marketing Analyst
description: About Downtown Engineers Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands. Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States, with a strong focus on New York City. We're a remote-first team of 20+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy, and that's how we communicate too. About the Opportunity Downtown is growing and we need someone to build and run the marketing infrastructure that supports it. As a Growth Marketing Analyst, you'll work across three fronts — recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition —designing strategies, setting up campaigns, configuring tools and measuring what converts. Your primary focus is on capture and expansion (website, CRM, events, paid media, referral systems, client retention), while supporting the demand layer fed by content and authority. This role works in close partnership with leadership and sales. You'll think about where to invest and how to grow, then make it happen, connecting marketing efforts to pipeline, testing what works, cutting what doesn't and scaling what proves itself. Compensation & Structure Full-time contractor (remote) Fixed monthly compensation Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application What you’ll do 1.Channel oversight & growth Set and track channel-level goals aligned with Downtown's growth priorities: recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition Own the day-to-day management and growth of marketing channels — email, paid media, outbound, events and future channels Plan, execute and optimize paid campaigns, including budget management and audience targeting Support the design and execution of outbound and ABM initiatives Optimize website performance as a conversion engine — landing pages, CTAs, user flow and lead capture Monitor organic search performance and identify SEO opportunities to support inbound growth Propose and test new campaigns, formats and acquisition strategies to improve performance 2.CRM & automation Own the marketing layer of the CRM (Zoho) in partnership with sales: title: Solution Consultant
description:
Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B)About SisenseSisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for over 2,000 global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence, including the Intelligence Assistant (natural-language analytics creation), Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (secure external LLM integration), and Managed LLM capabilities, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences at enterprise scale.The RoleAs a Solution Consultant on our Field Engineering team, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to strategic customers, guiding them through complex analytics and data initiatives to achieve measurable business outcomes. You will lead technical discovery, design best-practice solution architectures, and partner closely with customers and internal teams to ensure successful, scalable deployments across cloud-native and embedded environments.Why Join Our Field Engineering Services TeamYou'll operate at the intersection of customer success, product innovation, and business impact. This role gives you direct influence over high-value implementations, the opportunity to shape product direction through customer insights, and the chance to work on cutting-edge AI-embedded analytics projects with global enterprises. You'll collaborate with diverse teams while driving real value for customers and contributing to Sisense's growth.Responsibilities- Partner directly with customers to accelerate analytics initiatives, recommend scalable architectures, and align technical solutions with long-term business goals.- Lead deep technical discovery sessions to understand customer data maturity, use cases, and operational constraints.- Own the technical customer relationship as a trusted advisor, guiding solution design across cloud-native, embedded, and secure analytics environments.- Design, review, and optimize data models, queries, and analytical workflows to support performant, scalable solutions.- Deliver onboarding sessions, solution walkthroughs, and enablement workshops tailored to customers with intermediate to advanced data and analytics maturity.- Create and deliver customized technical presentations and demonstrations for audiences ranging from hands-on practitioners to executive stakeholders.- Provide guidance on authentication, security, and access control concepts, including SSO patterns and user-level data access strategies.- Consult on embedding analytics into applications, including session handling and integration best practices.- Support solution reviews, migrations, upgrades, and architectural optimizations across customer environments.- Assist customers with platform administration and configuration tasks, including API automation and environment setup.- Collaborate closely with internal engineering, product, and support teams to surface customer feedback, identify issues, and influence future enhancements.- Capture and share best practices, reference architectures, and technical assets to scale knowledge across customers and internal teams.- Evangelize Sisense best practices through workshops, community engagement, and technical thought leadership.About You- 3-5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role (e.G., Solution Consultant, Pre-Sales Engineer, Technical Consultant, Implementation Specialist, or similar).- Hands-on experience with modern BI and analytics platforms (Sisense preferred;
Tableau, Looker, PowerBI, or similar acceptable).- Proven success leading or contributing to complex BI, cloud, or data platform implementations, from discovery through delivery.- Strong data modeling expertise within a BI context, including dimensional modeling and working with large, complex datasets.- SQL proficiency: understands join types, normalization - has the ability to join data across disparate sources, optimize queries, and design efficient analytical models.- Experience designing and delivering customized technical presentations and product demonstrations for audiences ranging from hands-on practitioners to executive stakeholders.- Ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value, adapting communication style to technical and non-technical audiences alike.- Solid technical foundation, including experience with:- JavaScript, HTML/CSS (nice to have;
strong preference for hands-on exposure)- REST APIs and platform integrations- Linux-based environments and containerized architectures (Docker, Kubernetes)- Experience providing guidance on authentication and security, including implementing or supporting SSO solutions (SAML 2.0, OIDC, JWT).- Detailed understanding of analytics embedding, including hands-on implementation using iFrames and related integration patterns.- Working knowledge of ETL methodologies, data pipelines, and upstream data preparation concepts.- Nice to have: prior experience with technical project management or leading workstreams across cross-functional teams.What We Offer- Employment through a partner agency (B2B).- Competitive base salary up to USD 4300 per month (depending on experience).- Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics.- Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team.- Professional development and growth opportunities.
